$comment: Curated per-club colour maps for the DERIVED reversed cut, reviewed on a dark render and on club colour 2026-09-20. See docs/plans/nfl-mark-assignments.md § 'The reversals we are keeping'. THREE clubs, not the ten the mechanical pass nominated — ATL, BUF, CLE, HOU, LV and TB rendered acceptably and were declined on review, so their absence is a decision, not an oversight. Every `from` colour must still be present in the club's committed SVG or the build fails (tests/nfl-mark-reversals.test.ts): a logo refresh that moves a fill turns a reversal into a no-op or a mess.

ARI.note: Matches the Fox broadcast cut. The keyline is the club primary, not a brighter red — a brighter one was rendered alongside and club red was chosen on review.

DET.note: A white lion that KEEPS its interior detail. The mane, face and leg lines are a separate white layer over the blue body, so reversing the body alone merged them into it and flattened the lion to a silhouette — the detail layer takes Honolulu blue so it still reads, exactly inverting the light mark.

WSH.note: GOLD, not white — a straight swap of the club's two colours. 'Reversed' is not a synonym for 'knocked out to white': the body takes the club's other colour, whichever reads on a dark ground.
